acceptance: Gating trunk medium shards load neither pytest_cov nor the timeout plugin; shard durations return near the pre-coverage 7-15 min (observed on a real run)
trunk-coverage.yml publishes a v2 map; a PR's ci-paths loads it and records elapsed seconds and peak RSS under a stated budget
Unit tests cover v2 build and lookup, setup-phase expansion, statement filtering, failed-node inclusion, runtime cap, timeout cap, and fetch error vs not-found
The staleness signal fires on a fixture and is documented
docs/internal/merge-queue-governance.md section 5 describes the split, the cap rationale and the signal
context: Merged in #3245 (74ebc1560). Post-merge evidence (2026-10-22): gating Trunk run 39781259427 medium-test shards 0-3 took 362, 460, 432 and 419 s, and shard 0's log of run 39657416518 had no pytest_cov mentions. trunk-coverage.yml published v2 maps (first t2-coverage-map-74ebc1560..., 3.7 MB). PR #3264's ci-paths job (CI run 39794063479, job 119876905227) logged 'coverage map found' for develop ancestor d7f8cb1f6 with elapsed=21.6s rss=1384.5MB (v1 was 44.6 s / 2.2 GB); artifact coverage-selection-3264-68de1e483. Unit tests exist on develop: test_coverage_test_selection.py, test_coverage_map_staleness.py, test_pytest_coverage_timeout.py, test_trunk_coverage_workflow.py; docs section 5 covers the split, the 1200 s cap rationale and the daily staleness job. Remaining gap: no budget for the selection step's elapsed time and RSS was stated; a 60 s / 3 GB budget is being added to merge-queue-governance.md in PR #3237. Close when that merges.
description: Per-test coverage in trunk.yml made Trunk runs ~31.5 min (run 39596269177; shard 0 pytest 1580 s of a 33 min budget; ClickBench test_generate_data 628 s vs 65.8 s) and #3222 scaled every timeout 8x, so a hang can exceed the job limit. Owner decision: separate workflow. Steps: (1) trunk.yml medium-test back to uninstrumented runs with real timeouts and ci.yml duration-weighted sharding; (2) new .github/workflows/trunk-coverage.yml on push to develop, concurrency group trunk-coverage with cancel-in-progress, permissions contents+actions read, 4 coverage shards plus map job, never part of the arm gate; TRUNK_WORKFLOW_PATH provenance points at it; (3) timeout plugin min(t*8, 1200) with rationale 1200 s ~ 1.9x the worst measured coverage runtime (628 s); coverage-specific durations; (4) map job if: always() when all 4 shard data files exist, records failed node IDs which select always includes, --expected-shards 4 literal, retention-days 7; (5) map v2: node table with per-line integer indices, per-file executable-statement sets (changed blank/comment/docstring lines ignored), keep context phase and expand only setup-phase hits to the whole test module, replace the node-count cap with an estimated-runtime cap from the durations file; (6) fetch-map distinguishes 'no map published' from 'lookup failed' (::warning::), and the map job self-fetches the map it published; (7) owner-visible staleness signal (nightly-v2 domain or scheduled job opening/updating one issue) when the newest map is >20 commits behind develop or the coverage workflow failed 3 runs in a row; (8) tests/conftest.py coverage warning honours COVERAGE_FILE.
